title: Complete response accounting and finite-term correction
note: Maintainer certificate renewal after Borealis confirmed omitted field reduction and Delta established the scoped scalar target-touch lower bound. The complete compositional scalar construction has gates ≤ 100233080, depth ≤ 20037 and product ≤ 2008370223960. These construction upper bounds do not prove the declared minimum resource prices. The conditional ideal envelope changes from 0.049330348213215253 to 0.049330348228363684; the dominant-term floor remains 173.391078499301 bits. The six incomplete schedule metrics in the two earlier official baselines are withdrawn from current metric selection, without rewriting their evidence. Reviews: https://git.parano1d.org/ignotusnemo/parano1d-soundness/pulls/9 and https://git.parano1d.org/ignotusnemo/parano1d-soundness/pulls/11. Calculation: https://git.parano1d.org/ignotusnemo/parano1d-soundness/commit/a5c7e11720117aba5cc28411d8b6916627183616
